reasons.window_exceeded: days_since_delivery 41 exceeds the stated 30-day return window, so the item has been held past the window; the delay claim does not change the elapsed count from delivery.
reasons.return_outcome: Permissive posture, gold tier, unopened and therefore resellable goods, and a service-failure claim favour concession, but the overrun is 11 days beyond a 30-day window and the stated one-week delay explains only part of it, so full refund is favoured over credit or decline without being certain and a supervisor exception remains a live branch.
reasons.goodwill_case_strength: The late-delivery note is a concrete service failure and the item is unopened from a gold-tier customer, which supports a real but partial excuse since the claimed one-week delay accounts for only about 7 of the 11 overrun days.
